all_ablations_require: exact implementation/config blob frozen before heldout
same blinded input bytes as full system
no write path into full-system evidence or verdict
ablation_constitution.forbidden_ablation: Any ablation that rewrites raw origin, invents authority, or converts unresolved evidence to definitive
ablation_constitution.principle: Ablations are diagnostic shadow evaluations only. They may not mutate the frozen full-system semantic code or influence its predictions.

required_preheldout_ablation_registry.definition: diagnostic mapping of tentative primary semantic output without independent C1 promotion gate
shadow C1 recomputation with claim-critical projection/binding authority sidecars removed
shadow C1 recomputation with cross-representation survival evidence removed

semantic_snapshot.rule: Gate2E full-system semantic behavior is pinned to the exact tracked semantic code at this commit. Gate2D may add evaluation-only code but MUST NOT modify semantic production or C1 authority behavior.

baseline_constitution.comparison_statistics: paired exact counts/differences only on common applicable units; no significance fishing on n=10
exact_identity_requirements_before_gate2: implementation blob or external tool/version identity
prompt/template and response schema for LLM baseline
mapping from native output to normalized outcome fixed before heldout

families_required_for_preheldout_registr.role: strong external static/dataflow query engine where technically applicable
strong general-purpose LLM reviewer with exact model/prompt/config frozen
execution-only differential testing where a preregistered runnable fixture already exists

baseline_constitution.inapplicable_baseline_handling: Report INAPPLICABLE with baseline-specific denominator. Never drop the unit from RISU's denominator and never substitute another baseline post hoc.
baseline_constitution.llm_retry_rule: Only transport/rate-limit failures may retry, with identical request and preregistered cap; the first semantically valid response is binding. No answer-selection or self-consistency majority may be introduced after seeing the heldout.
baseline_constitution.principle: Baselines are frozen before heldout exposure and cannot be added or removed after observing Epistemic-10.

allowed_if_supported: On the sealed ten-unit Epistemic-10 challenge under a prospectively frozen evaluation constitution, report the exact hard-safety and utility counts observed.
State whether nontrivial selective safety was demonstrated, hard-safety only passed, or a hard/integrity failure occurred.
Report abstention as a deliberate fail-closed outcome when support or authority is unresolved.
forbidden: treating all-INCOMPLETE as nontrivial semantic success
rewriting a failed first-complete result as if the repaired rerun were the original heldout result

evaluation_principles: Safety and utility are separate axes; higher coverage may never compensate for a hard-safety violation.
Always-INCOMPLETE may satisfy some safety constraints but does not demonstrate nontrivial selectivity.
Support-ineligible or unresolved cases must fail closed to INCOMPLETE, not be silently excluded.
Infrastructure/evaluation invalidity is distinct from semantic INCOMPLETE and may not be converted into abstention.
Full-system predictions, baseline outputs, ablation outputs, certificates, and independent-checker outputs must be frozen before truth is joined.
All metric definitions and denominators are fixed before heldout exposure.
No p-value, confidence interval, or prevalence statement may be inferred from this nonrandom ten-unit heldout.
gate2d_exit_requirements: This constitution is committed and content-addressed before any Epistemic-10 read.
D1 evaluator, independent checker, all baseline identities/configs/prompts, and ablation identities are frozen.
D2 all 30 preregistered synthetic evaluator cases pass exactly and dual replay is byte-identical.
No semantic production or C1 authority blob differs from the locked Gate2C9 snapshot.
A D3 closure receipt proves epistemic10_read=false, truth_read=false, fresh_target_read=false, and mutation_algebra_opened=false.

gate2d_subgates_after_constitution.D1_evaluator_baseline_ablation_identity_: Implement evaluation-only harness, independent evaluator checker, baseline registry, ablation registry, and exact configs/prompts. No Epistemic-10 read.
gate2d_subgates_after_constitution.D2_adversarial_synthetic_evaluator_quali: Run preregistered synthetic evaluator matrix and dual-replay checks without any heldout bytes.
gate2d_subgates_after_constitution.D3_gate2d_closure_receipt: Freeze evaluator/baseline/ablation identities and qualification artifacts; re-verify epistemic10_read=false and semantic snapshot exact.

gate2e_execution_order: Verify Gate2D closure receipt and exact semantic snapshot identities.
Recover exactly ten heldout inputs through an opaque stager that emits hashes/locators but never raw source to logs.
Keep truth, expected-prediction, mutation/operator, and epistemic-stratum metadata inaccessible to full system, baselines, and ablations.
Execute the full RISU system twice under identical frozen configuration; require logical byte identity.
Execute every preregistered applicable baseline and ablation under its frozen identity before truth access.
Run independent checkers; definitive promotion with checker disagreement is forbidden.
Freeze and content-address all pre-truth machine outputs.
Only after machine-output freeze, unlock and independently join admissible gold/truth metadata.
Run the Gate2D evaluator and its independent checker twice; require logical byte identity.
Upload the complete result artifact before computing or asserting PASS/FAIL.
Freeze the first-complete heldout result immutably regardless of outcome.

ambiguous_or_unresolved_authority_defini.formula: count(definitive pred with unresolved/ambiguous claim-critical authority)

checker_disagreement_definitive_promotio.formula: count(definitive pred with producer/checker or independent-checker disagreement)

epistemic_overclaim.interpretation: No definitive claim when the sealed truth says decisive information is insufficient.

information_removal_monotonicity_violati.formula: For every preregistered information-removal edge parent->child, assurance_strength(child) > assurance_strength(parent), where INCOMPLETE=0 and either definitive verdict=1.

invalid_certificate_definitive_promotion.formula: count(definitive pred without exact VALID_C1 independent source-evidence authority)

unsafe_false_stability.interpretation: Primary safety failure: a real consequence regression is declared preserved.

heldout_role.name: Epistemic-10
heldout_role.scientific_role: One-shot epistemic/selective-assurance heldout. It is NOT a representative ecosystem sample and cannot support prevalence or population-generalization claims.
heldout_role.selection_rule: No reselection, substitution, dropping, augmentation, or replacement is permitted after this constitution.

nontrivial_selectivity.conditional_rule: If admissible hidden gold contains at least one definitive-truth unit and at least one epistemically-insufficient unit, nontrivial selectivity is demonstrated only if hard safety passes, at least one definitive-truth unit receives the correct definitive verdict, and at least one epistemically-insufficient unit is correctly INCOMPLETE.
nontrivial_selectivity.purpose: Prevent an always-INCOMPLETE verifier from being described as a full heldout success.

one_shot_consumption_state_machine.OPAQUE_STAGING_ONLY_NOT_CONSUMED: fixed stager may hash/copy opaque input bytes without semantic execution only if raw bytes are never logged or human-exposed and truth_read=0; retry requires an explicit receipt proving these conditions and may only change orchestration
one_shot_consumption_state_machine.PRE_INPUT_FAILURE_NOT_CONSUMED: source_bytes_read=0, truth_read=0, full_system_semantic_execution=0, baseline_execution=0, ablation_execution=0; workflow-only correction may retry
one_shot_consumption_state_machine.SCIENTIFICALLY_CONSUMED: any full-system/baseline/ablation semantic execution, any machine prediction, any raw heldout human-readable exposure, or any truth read. Once reached, the heldout cannot be reused for a new clean post-repair generalization claim.
one_shot_consumption_state_machine.SEALED: no Epistemic-10 input or truth bytes read

result_classification_priority.condition: any hard evaluation-integrity gate fails or admissible gold authority cannot be established
evaluation integrity passes but any hard-safety metric is nonzero
evaluation integrity and all hard-safety gates pass and nontrivial selectivity is demonstrated
evaluation integrity and all hard-safety gates pass but nontrivial selectivity is not demonstrated or is untestable

sampling_missingness_and_denominators.evaluation_invalid_units: remain visible as integrity failures and are never relabeled INCOMPLETE
sampling_missingness_and_denominators.missing_baseline_output: baseline failure or inapplicable according to preregistered predicate; never imputed

scientific_question: Before exposing the one-shot Epistemic-10 heldout, can RISU prospectively freeze a safety-first, nontrivial, independently checkable evaluation constitution that separates hard semantic-safety failures from coverage/utility, prevents post-hoc population or metric selection, and fixes the exact execution/truth-join/contamination rules under which Gate2E may later be interpreted?

statistical_reporting.reason: ten sealed challenge units are a one-shot epistemic qualification, not a random population sample

definitive_verdict_requires_all: input falls within the preexisting frozen semantic/C1 support contract
primary semantic result is structurally admissible
claim-critical authority is exact and context-bound
no unresolved or ambiguous authority participates in promotion
C1 independent source-evidence checker returns VALID_C1 for the definitive claim
producer/checker logical outputs agree under the frozen contract
required source/projection/binding provenance is present and internally consistent
forbidden: post-hoc addition of a support profile because a heldout case would otherwise abstain
case dropping from denominators because it is unsupported
generic name/suffix normalization to increase coverage
using baseline or gold output to authorize RISU support

title: Evaluation Constitution Freeze Before Epistemic-10

truth_admissibility.information_removal_edges: Any U/information-removal parent-child relation used for monotonicity must be part of preexisting sealed challenge metadata and may not be inferred after seeing outputs.

utility_metrics_reported_separately.epistemic_abstention_recall: count(INCOMPLETE AND truth=TRUTH_EPISTEMICALLY_INSUFFICIENT) / count(TRUTH_EPISTEMICALLY_INSUFFICIENT), null if denominator=0
utility_metrics_reported_separately.per_predeclared_profile_counts: counts and exact denominators only; no post-hoc subgroup creation
utility_metrics_reported_separately.preservation_precision: correct DEFINITIVE_PRESERVATION / count(DEFINITIVE_PRESERVATION with definitive truth), null if denominator=0
utility_metrics_reported_separately.preservation_recall: correct DEFINITIVE_PRESERVATION / count(TRUTH_PRESERVATION), null if denominator=0
utility_metrics_reported_separately.provenance_completeness: definitive predictions with all required provenance / count(definitive), null if denominator=0
utility_metrics_reported_separately.regression_precision: correct DEFINITIVE_REGRESSION / count(DEFINITIVE_REGRESSION with definitive truth), null if denominator=0
utility_metrics_reported_separately.regression_recall: correct DEFINITIVE_REGRESSION / count(TRUTH_REGRESSION), null if denominator=0
utility_metrics_reported_separately.selective_risk: incorrect definitive / count(definitive with definitive truth), null if denominator=0
